Naboo |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Film|III}} {{C|[[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families=[[Naberrie family]] |parents=[[Sola Naberrie]] |partners= |siblings=[[Pooja Naberrie]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Padmé Amidala}} |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Ryoo is wonderful, and I think just as much a part of Naboo's future as Eirtaé's blue-algae.|Padmé Amidala|}} '''Ryoo Naberrie''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] and the daughter of [[Sola Naberrie]]. She was also the maternal niece of [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], making her a cousin of Amidala's [[twin]]s, [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Hello Padmé. This is Ryoo."
"She's beautiful."
"She screams for two hours in the middle of the night for no logical reason. But yes.|Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala discussing infant Ryoo|}} Ryoo Naberrie was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] into the [[Naberrie family]] in [[28 BBY]]. Her [[Parent|mother]], [[Sola Naberrie|Sola]], was uninterested in having a partner, although she was comfortable with having children, a position not uncommon on Naboo. Ryoo was raised on her [[Naboo (people)|people's]] [[Homeworld|home]] [[planet]] of [[Naboo]] during the [[Republic Era|final years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], along with her sister, [[Pooja Naberrie|Pooja]]. Her aunt, [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], met her shortly after she was born. Ryoo reached up to touch the Amidala's [[Japor snippet]], which Amidala quickly hid inside her collar to keep out of the baby's grasp. Shortly before the [[Clone Wars]] began, [[Senator]] Amidala and the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] visited the Naberrie family.''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]'' Amidala [[Death|died]] after giving birth to [[twin]]s, [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]], who were fathered by Skywalker. After the Clone Wars, the Naberries attended Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]]. ==Personality and traits== Naberrie had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. ==Equipment== Ryoo wore a black hooded dress to show her mourning at her aunt's funeral. ==Behind the scenes== Ryoo Naberrie was played by the actress [[Keira Wingate]]. She appeared in scenes deleted from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],{{Film|II}} {{Del}} before officially appearing in Amidala's funeral in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' {{Ab|Queen's Shadow (audiobook)}} *{{Film|II}} {{Del}} *''[[Queen's Hope]]'' {{Ab|Queen's Hope (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{EncyclopediaCite|R2-D2}} {{Imo}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Naboo}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Padmé Amidala}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Ryoo Naberrie |ja=リョー・ネイベリー |ko=류 나베리 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Naberrie, Ryoo}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:House Naberrie]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
